query: Can you guide me on how to notify authorities about faulty traffic signals in TN cities?
reference_answer:
Reporting Traffic Signal Malfunctions:
To report traffic signal malfunctions in Tamil Nadu cities, call the police control room (100) or contact the local traffic police station. You can also use the Tamil Nadu Police Department's mobile app or website to report the issue.
answer: To notify authorities about faulty traffic signals in TN cities, contact the local police station or the city’s traffic department directly. They will have the procedures for reporting such issues. [Document 1]
